name: NVDA vs AMD Relative Strength & Divergence Analysis
description: Research study comparing NVDA and AMD relative strength over 2 years. Includes normalized price performance, price ratio with moving average overlays, rolling return spread, rolling correlation, scatter of daily returns, and a summary table of key ratio metrics to identify divergence trade setups.
source:
# =============================================================================
# NVDA vs AMD RELATIVE STRENGTH & DIVERGENCE ANALYSIS
# =============================================================================
# Compares NVDA and AMD over time to identify:
#   - Which stock is leading (normalized performance, ratio trend)
#   - Whether a divergence trade is setting up (spread, correlation, ratio momentum)
#
# Charts:
#   1. Summary table: key ratio metrics (total return, ratio level, 52w hi/lo, momentum)
#   2. cs_lines: normalized price performance indexed to 100
#   3. xy_lines: NVDA/AMD price ratio with 20d and 60d MA
#   4. xy_lines: rolling 60-day return spread (NVDA - AMD)
#   5. xy_lines: rolling 60-day correlation
#   6. xy_scatter: NVDA daily returns vs AMD daily returns
# =============================================================================

# --- Data Sources ---
# Market data for the universe (used for cs_lines normalized chart)
src = market_data_source()()
close = src.c

# Load reference data for NVDA and AMD (used for per-asset paired analysis)
nvda_o, nvda_h, nvda_l, nvda_c, nvda_v, nvda_vw, nvda_n = reference_stocks(ticker="NVDA")()
amd_o, amd_h, amd_l, amd_c, amd_v, amd_vw, amd_n = reference_stocks(ticker="AMD")()

nvda_close = ffill(nvda_c)
amd_close = ffill(amd_c)

# --- Normalized Performance (cs_lines) ---
# Daily returns for cumulative product → index to 100
daily_ret = returns(period=1)(close)
cum_ret = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Product)(1 + daily_ret)
norm_price = cum_ret * 100

bar_ts = index()

cs_lines(
    title='NVDA vs AMD Normalized Performance (Indexed to 100)',
    category='1. Relative Performance',
    y_axis_label='Index Level',
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=0,
    order=1
)(bar_ts, norm_price)

# --- NVDA/AMD Price Ratio with Moving Averages ---
ratio = nvda_close / amd_close
ratio_ma20 = ma(period=20)(ratio)
ratio_ma60 = ma(period=60)(ratio)

xy_lines(
    title='NVDA/AMD Price Ratio with 20d & 60d MA',
    category='1. Relative Performance',
    y_axis_label='Ratio (NVDA / AMD)',
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='NVDA/AMD Ratio', color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='20d MA', color=Color.Orange, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='60d MA', color=Color.Red, dash_style=DashStyle.LongDash)
    ]),
    order=2
)(bar_ts, ratio, ratio_ma20, ratio_ma60)

# --- Rolling 60-Day Return Spread (NVDA minus AMD) ---
nvda_ret = returns(period=1)(nvda_close)
amd_ret = returns(period=1)(amd_close)

# Rolling 60-day cumulative return for each
nvda_ret_60d = (nvda_close - (nvda_close >> 60)) / (nvda_close >> 60)
amd_ret_60d = (amd_close - (amd_close >> 60)) / (amd_close >> 60)
spread_60d = nvda_ret_60d - amd_ret_60d

xy_lines(
    title='Rolling 60-Day Return Spread (NVDA - AMD)',
    category='2. Momentum & Correlation',
    y_axis_label='Return Spread',
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=1,
    area=True,
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='NVDA - AMD Spread', color=Color.Blue)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title="0%")
    ]),
    order=3
)(bar_ts, spread_60d)

# --- Rolling 60-Day Correlation ---
corr_60d = rolling_corr(window=60)(nvda_ret, amd_ret)

xy_lines(
    title='Rolling 60-Day Correlation (NVDA vs AMD Daily Returns)',
    category='2. Momentum & Correlation',
    y_axis_label='Correlation',
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='60d Correlation', color=Color.Indigo)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.5, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title="0.50"),
        ReferenceLine(value=0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dot, title="0.00")
    ]),
    order=4
)(bar_ts, corr_60d)

# --- Scatter: NVDA vs AMD Daily Returns ---
xy_scatter(
    title='NVDA vs AMD Daily Returns',
    category='3. Return Relationship',
    x_axis_label='AMD Daily Return',
    y_axis_label='NVDA Daily Return',
    x_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.PercentFormat,
    x_axis_dp=1,
    y_axis_dp=1,
    show_trend_line=True,
    series=ScatterSeriesSchema(series=[
        ScatterSeriesSpec(name='Daily Returns', color=Color.Blue, marker=MarkerSymbol.CircleMarker)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title="0%")
    ]),
    order=5
)(amd_ret, nvda_ret)

# --- Summary Table: Key Ratio Metrics ---
# Total returns (from cumulative product of daily returns)
nvda_total_ret = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Product)(1 + nvda_ret) - 1
amd_total_ret = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Product)(1 + amd_ret) - 1

# 52-week (252 trading days) high and low of the ratio
ratio_52w_high = max(period=252)(ratio)
ratio_52w_low = min(period=252)(ratio)

# Ratio momentum: 1M (~21 days), 3M (~63 days), 6M (~126 days) change
ratio_chg_1m = (ratio - (ratio >> 21)) / (ratio >> 21)
ratio_chg_3m = (ratio - (ratio >> 63)) / (ratio >> 63)
ratio_chg_6m = (ratio - (ratio >> 126)) / (ratio >> 126)

summary_table(
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
        title='NVDA vs AMD Ratio Summary',
        row_size=8,
        col_size=1,
        row_headers=['NVDA Total Return', 'AMD Total Return', 'Current Ratio', '52W Ratio High', '52W Ratio Low', 'Ratio 1M Chg', 'Ratio 3M Chg', 'Ratio 6M Chg'],
        cells=[
            ColumnSpec(title='NVDA Total Return', grid_row=0, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(title='AMD Total Return', grid_row=1, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(title='Current Ratio', grid_row=2, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(title='52W High', grid_row=3, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(title='52W Low', grid_row=4, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(title='1M Change', grid_row=5, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(title='3M Change', grid_row=6, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(title='6M Change', grid_row=7, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2)
        ]
    ),
    category='1. Relative Performance',
    order=0
)(nvda_total_ret, amd_total_ret, ratio, ratio_52w_high, ratio_52w_low, ratio_chg_1m, ratio_chg_3m, ratio_chg_6m)
